target: WIN-049 detail_evidence: replace unverifiable '1.48% at the equator' with mathematically correct '0.2% at the disc edge (20,015 km)'
tldr_evidence: Curmudgeon c7 verified: under h^3/r^3 with h=2534 km, the disc edge (x=20,015 km) gives 0.20%, not 1.48%. The 1.48% corresponds to x≈10,005 km — an arbitrary offset with no dome-geometric meaning. Replacing with disc-edge value is mathematically correct and makes the spatial-concentration argument stronger.
tldr_verdict: Drop '1.48% at the equator' (unverifiable, geometrically undefined) and replace with '0.2% at the disc edge (20,015 km)' (correct under cited falloff law; disc edge is the strongest natural reference point in dome geometry). Option (b) from curmudgeon c7 recommendation.

math_verification.conclusion: 1.48% is numerically consistent with the falloff law but references an unmarked interior point (~10,005 km). The disc edge at 20,015 km gives 0.2%, which is geometrically unambiguous and makes a stronger argument (tidal force is essentially zero across most of the disc).
